run_protoc_plugin_tests: run the gRPC protoc plugin split definitions test suite with unittest
create_directory_tree: create a nested directory tree from a sequence of path component lists
massage_proto_content: substitute package namespaces and import paths in raw proto file content
packagify_directory: add empty __init__.py files to all subdirectories under a given directory
invoke_protoc: invoke grpc_tools.protoc.main with configurable proto_path, python_out, and grpc_python_out flags
